ModMetaData.name: Ra2Bunker Endpoint LOS Fix V5
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5.4063 LOS fix for Ra2Bunker. The bunker keeps its original partial fill and is treated as opaque by default. During LOS and shooting calculations, only the exact bunker acting as source or target is temporarily exempted across its 3x3 footprint, allowing bunker occupants to fight outside while preventing outside-to-outside sight and fire through the bunker.
